title: Proliferation Assay for PBMCs and NK Cells
author: Philippa R Kennedy
materials: PBMCs or enriched NK cells (see Isolating NK cells from human blood products ) are labeled with a permanent amine-reactive dye (CellTrace Violet Proliferation Kit, Cat. No:C34557, Thermo Fisher) according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Optional: If required, cells can be stained for apoptotic markers (FITC Annexin V, Cat. No: 556419, BD Biosciences) according to the manufacturer's instructions prior to antibody staining.

Cells are stained with a dead cell marker (LIVE/DEAD NEAR-IR, Cat. No: L34976, Thermo Fisher), PE-CY7 conjugated anti-CD56 (HCD56, BioLegend), and PE-CF594 conjugated anti-CD3 (UCHT1, BD BioSciences).

PBMCs or enriched NK cells (see Isolating NK cells from human blood products ) are labeled with a permanent amine-reactive dye (CellTrace Violet Proliferation Kit, Cat. No:C34557, Thermo Fisher) according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Optional: If required, cells can be stained for apoptotic markers (FITC Annexin V, Cat. No: 556419, BD Biosciences) according to the manufacturer's instructions prior to antibody staining.

steps.title: Culture and Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Expose PBMCs and NK cells to experimental conditions and culture for 7 days before harvesting.

steps.title: Analyze Proliferation via Flow Cytometry
steps.instruction: Run harvested samples on a flow cytometer (LSRII, BD Biosciences) and analyze data using FlowJo software (Tree Star Inc., RRID:SCR_008520).

substeps.instruction: Assess proliferation of live NK cells (CD56+/CD3-) and T cells (CD56-/CD3+) by dye dilution, ensuring cells are dead cell marker- and annexin V-.
Determine relative numbers of live NK and T cells for each condition by running the cytometer at a constant flow rate and counting cell types within a specified time limit (e.g., 60s).
